i.norm: Tests that StrSubstitutor correctly replaces a variable within a substring range, and that replaceIn on a buffer with no unresolved variables returns false. The mock StrMatcher drives the prefix/suffix detection: isMatch returns 0,0 (no match) then 1 (prefix found) then 5 (suffix found 5 chars later). The mock StrLookup resolves any variable name to "fYxE". replace("Q3N]D,Um> EQt", offset=1, length=5) processes the slice "3N]D," and yields "3N" + "fYxE" = "3NfYxE" once the variable is substituted.
Arrange: a lookup that resolves every variable name to "fYxE"
Arrange: a matcher used for both prefix and suffix detection. isMatch returns 0 (no match), 0 (no match), 1 (prefix matched), 5 (suffix matched), 1694.
Arrange: substitutor with custom escape char '1', using the same matcher for prefix and suffix
Act: replace within the substring at offset 1, length 5 of "Q3N]D,Um> EQt" The processed slice is "3N]D," — the variable inside resolves to "fYxE"
Assert: the variable region was substituted, producing "3N" + "fYxE"
Act: attempt in-place replacement on a StringBuffer that contains no variable markers
Assert: no substitution occurred in the plain-text buffer
Assert: escape char is preserved as configured
